title: Second Run counter evaluation record
description: One operator's customer-facing evaluation: everything observable from signing up through releasing the machine, without touching the GPU. Every field not actually observed during the run this record documents MUST be the string "unobserved" -- never a guess, never a value carried in from marketing copy or another operator's run. counter_record.py validates and scores this shape without a jsonschema dependency; this file is the human-readable reference and is not itself consumed by the script.

provider_id.description: lowercase slug, matches providers/SCHEMA.md's provider_id convention, e.g. hotaisle, digitalocean

provenance.description: Who ran this evaluation, when, on what account, at what cost, and under what disclosure. Never 'unobserved' -- provenance is always known to the evaluator.

evaluator.description: person or handle who ran the evaluation

evaluated_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of the evaluation session's start

account_used.description: e.g. 'new account, sign-up this session' or 'existing campaign account'

money_spent_usd.description: total dollars actually charged during this evaluation

disclosure.description: one plain line: funding relationship, credits used, or 'none' -- see DISCLOSURES.md convention

account_creation.description: Sign-up friction: KYC, card, quota gates, sales gate.

kyc_required.description: identity document or business verification beyond email + card

card_required.description: a payment card must be added before any compute can be rented

quota_gate.description: one of: none, soft (support ticket raises a default-zero limit), hard (must be approved before any create), sales

sales_gate.description: true if a sales conversation is required before self-serve access to the SKU under test

signup_to_active_account_s.description: wall-clock seconds from starting sign-up to being able to attempt a create

price_transparency.description: Published pricing for the SKU under test.

published.description: price is visible on a public page without login

per_gpu_hour_usd.description: list price per GPU-hour for the SKU under test, USD

storage_rate.description: e.g. price per GB-month for retained disk, or 'none'

provisioning.description: Time to SSH from request. Measure 3 times only if the total spend for all 3 stays under $3; otherwise record one measurement and say why.

attempts.description: one entry per timed provisioning attempt, in order

request_ts.description: UTC ISO 8601, moment create was requested

ssh_ready_ts.description: UTC ISO 8601, moment SSH first succeeded, or 'unobserved' if it never did

measured_3x.description: true only if 3 independent attempts are recorded in attempts[]

total_cost_usd.description: dollars spent across all provisioning attempts in this section

availability_honesty.description: Does the listed SKU actually provision? Each attempt is also written to the campaign's availability/observations.jsonl ledger in its documented format (ts, provider, region, sku, gpus, method, layer, outcome, provisioned, ...); ledger_attempts below mirrors that shape so this record is self-contained.

method.description: api-create, console-create, or tui-provision, per availability/README.md

outcome.description: available, out_of_capacity, out_of_stock, create_failed, ssh_failed, or unknown

list_op.description: can list existing resources via API/CLI/TUI

idempotent_create.description: repeating the same create call does not silently double-provision

idempotent_delete.description: repeating delete on an already-deleted resource errors cleanly rather than corrupting state

billing_granularity.description: Billing quantum and stop-on-delete, verified against the invoice or account balance, not just the pricing page.

billing_quantum.description: e.g. 'per second, 60s minimum' -- record page vs docs discrepancies in notes

stop_on_delete_verified.description: true only if balance/invoice was checked before and after delete and showed billing stopped at delete time

invoice_matches_balance.description: the posted invoice/statement line matches the account balance deduction

tenant_hygiene.description: Evidence the machine was actually reset between tenants.

fresh_disk.description: root disk shows no files/history from a prior tenant

previous_tenant_residue.description: true if any file, log, shell history, or credential from a previous tenant was found -- disqualifying if true

default_users_keys_present.description: unexpected default/shared user accounts or pre-installed SSH keys not supplied by this evaluator

network_path.description: What the box looks like on the network on first boot, before any hardening.

open_ports_first_boot.description: list of open TCP/UDP port numbers observed on first boot, an empty list if a scan ran and found none, or the string 'unobserved' if no scan ran

support_path.description: Support channel and response time, exercised with one real question.

sales_required.description: true if reaching support required going through a sales contact form

termination.description: Releasing the machine and confirming billing stopped.

method.description: e.g. 'console delete', 'TUI delete', 'API delete', 'support ticket required'

time_to_confirm_s.description: seconds from delete request to the resource disappearing from the active list

disqualifying_observations.description: Free-text list of observations that, if any are present, cap the counter score at 40 regardless of the weighted total (see counter_record.py DISQUALIFYING_CAP). Empty list means none observed. Examples: previous-tenant residue found, billing did not stop at delete, sales gate blocks self-serve access to the SKU under test.
